triage_protocol.protocol: When a port congestion event exceeds 72 hours dwell time, query alternate inland intermodal rail and trucking hubs within a 350-mile radius.
Calculate total landed cost delta including storage demurrage fees before proposing cargo rerouting plans.
If third-party freight tracking APIs time out (HTTP 503), fall back to cached AIS satellite positional telemetry and flag estimated confidence as 'DEGRADED'.
Rerouting plans exceeding $25,000 variance require VP of Logistics authorization.
